card_comparison: All ten posed questions are represented in source order: five true/false questions in Part I and five longer problems in Part II. The source includes worked answers, which remain source provenance rather than being imported as authored solutions.
known_extractor_defects: Part II Problem 5 mangles the symmetric-square notation in the problem line. The same deterministic extraction's worked solution repeatedly identifies the induced operator as S^2 f, so the card records the intended identity 2 tr(S^2 f) = tr(f)^2 + tr(f^2).
